subsystem.name: UIPlatformAndOptions
subsystem.responsibility: Menu and options platform: a shared UI element constructor/display template with bound data pointers, menu page rebuilds (race standings, team stats, game options), the network game browser and VCR replay browser lists, menu-item text fitting and truncation, list object destruction, and the main text render dispatcher with alignment and string-table resolution.

summary: The packet covers the UI platform and options subsystem: a constructor template shared by many UI elements (base-init, vtable install, bound-data pointer at +0x31C, config flags at +0x324..+0x330, value preset at +0x334, text-handle list registration) with display-update methods that format values into a checked buffer and push them to the UI edit buffer; menu page objects that rebuild an entry linked list at +0x44..+0x50 (race-standings pages, team statistics, game options by category); list-driven browsers (network game sessions, VCR replay files); a menu-item text-fit measurer and a render dispatcher that resolves string-table tokens, derives alignment, fits/truncates text, and draws by alignment mode; and a UI list destructor. Owners are largely UNKNOWN in the packet; only the camera constructor carries a DERIVED owner label (UICamera). Architecture is a DERIVED/GUESS proposal; equal offsets on base 'this' are grouped conservatively and contested dual-use fields are flagged in unresolved.

function_roles.role: Display-update method: stores the driving-mode globals, applies driving-mode parameters, reads the list-index value through the double-dereferenced pointer at +0x320, formats it into a checked stack buffer, and pushes the string into the UI edit buffer; returns 0.
UI element constructor: base-init, vtable off_5A2880 install, bound-data pointer to dword_7D032C at +0x31C, config flags 1/0/1/1, preset 271 at +0x334, registration of two text-handle nodes.

Counter display update: returns 0 immediately when the global dword_7D0110 equals the cached value at +0x31C, else caches it and formats a list string or the raw integer ('%d') into the edit buffer; returns 0.
Constructor: base-init, vtable off_5A3000, pointer to the AuthorizationBypassFlag global dword_7CF638 at +0x31C, flags 1/0/1/1, preset 381, two text-handle nodes, virtual dispatch init.
Constructor: base-init, vtable off_5A3180, pointer to unk_7CFBD8 at +0x31C, flags 1/0/1/1, preset 383, two text-handle nodes, virtual dispatch init.
Constructor: base-init, vtable off_5A3240, pointer to unk_7CFBB4 at +0x31C, flags 1/0/1/1, preset 384, two text-handle nodes, virtual dispatch init.
Constructor: base-init, vtable off_5A3300, pointer unk_7CFD10 at +0x31C, flags 1/0/1/1, preset 385, text nodes off_5C32A4 and aHigh, virtual dispatch init.
Constructor: base-init, vtable off_5A33C0, pointer dword_7CFC68 at +0x31C, flags 2/0/1/1, preset 386, three text nodes (off_5BE704, off_5C32A4, aHigh); no virtual dispatch init.
Constructor: base-init, vtable off_5A3480, data-source pointer unk_7CF764 at +0x31C, state fields 2/0/1/1, component id 387 at +0x334, three text nodes, virtual dispatch init.
Camera UI constructor: base-init, vtable off_5A3CC0, data pointer unk_7CFC44 at +0x31C, config flags 1/0/1/1, preset 398, text nodes off_5BE704 and aOn, virtual dispatch init.
Constructor/initializer: base-init sub_48C070, vtable off_5A4200, registration of two resource nodes (unk_5C6E18, off_5C6E14) with index -1; no guards.

Network game browser list update: reads search text, notifies state cleanup, sorts sessions by filter, builds one menu row per session (description + translated name + '%d/%d' players + '%d' id), sets row outline color by locked/joined and player-count flags, restores search selection, and shows a Searching/No-games-available status item when no rows exist.
Game-filter UI object constructor: base UI object constructor, zeroes the query/index at +0x40, sets record sentinel -1 at +0x44, installs the off_5A4478 vtable; called once by GameFilterSetup.

Menu-item text-fit measurer: loads the text buffer pointer at +0xE0, measures characters against the available width with TextRenderToSurface, and returns the character index at which the menu-item text must be truncated.

VCR replay file browser rebuild: scans the replay directory with the aVcr_0 pattern, strips file extensions, creates one UI menu item per file, re-selects the saved file name, and resets the search-result list.

Menu page rebuild: frees the entry-list node chain at +0x44, notifies state cleanup, stores the page direction at +0x174, builds one menu item per race-standings entry (scene name + position number), skips names already present, installs red/black title strings and the list management handler for the page direction.

Team statistics menu build: resolves the team record through the global accessor, frees and clears the entry list at +0x44, inserts seven stat category headers, creates seven formatted stat menu items plus a final separator-only item.

Game options constructor: base vtable init, clears the legacy list at +0x44, stores the option category argument at +0xF4, then inserts the label set selected by category via the jump table (Allowed/Disallowed, On/Off, Normal+X2..X7, Normal/TimeScaled/SelectedSeason).

List object destructor: frees three buffer pointers (+0x150/+0x158/+0x160), runs conditional cleanup on two sub-objects (+0xE0/+0x118), chains to the base destructor, and frees the object itself when the delete flag is set.

Main text render dispatcher: resolves the stored text through the string table when flagged, derives the alignment mode from the alignment string, measures and fits/truncates the text against the width limit, re-centers on overflow, dispatches the draw by alignment mode, and writes the final rectangle to out-parameters; returns 0.

classes.name: UIElementBase
classes.responsibility: Shared UI element template used by most constructors in the packet: base-init via ShortComputation_6d60(this, 1), vtable install, bound-data pointer at +0x31C, four config/state fields at +0x324..+0x330, value preset at +0x334, and registration of text-handle nodes into an internal linked list. Also hosts display-update methods that format a list string or integer into a checked stack buffer and push it into the UI edit buffer.

classes.name: UICamera
classes.responsibility: Camera control UI element constructed with the same template as UIElementBase: base-init, vtable off_5A3CC0, bound-data pointer unk_7CFC44 at +0x31C, config flags 1/0/1/1, preset 398, text-handle registration. Prior analysis labels this owner DERIVED; whether it inherits UIElementBase is not proven.

classes.name: UIMenuPage
classes.responsibility: Menu page object owning an entry linked list at +0x44..+0x50. Rebuilds one page of entries (race-standings pages, team statistics, game options): frees the old node chain, notifies state cleanup, inserts entries selected by category/page direction, and creates formatted menu items. Concrete subtypes stamp category (+0xF4), page direction (+0x174) or scene-name fields (+0xA0/+0xA8).

classes.name: UIListTextItem
classes.responsibility: Constructor-style initializer for a proposed UI list text item: base-init sub_48C070(this, 1), vtable off_5A4200, registration of two resource-handle nodes (unk_5C6E18, off_5C6E14) with index -1.

classes.name: UINetworkGameBrowser
classes.responsibility: Network game browser menu state: reads the search text, sorts the session list from the session manager (dword_7CD25C), builds one menu row per session with a locked/joined-dependent outline color, restores the search selection, and falls back to Searching/No-games-available status items.

classes.name: UIGameFilterObject
classes.responsibility: Game-filter UI object: base UI object constructor (0x0048FC50), query/index at +0x40, record sentinel -1 at +0x44, vtable off_5A4478; built by GameFilterSetup.

classes.name: VcrFileBrowser
classes.responsibility: VCR replay file browser: scans the replay directory with the aVcr_0 pattern through the file-search linked list (unk_8AD3B0), strips extensions, creates one menu item per file, re-selects the saved file name, and clears the selection flag at +0x131.

classes.name: UIMenuItemLayoutHelper
classes.responsibility: Menu-item text-fit measurer: loads the text buffer pointer at +0xE0 (falling back to byte_5EA438), measures characters against the available width, and returns the truncation index.

classes.name: UIListObject
classes.responsibility: UI list object whose destructor frees three buffer pointers (+0x150/+0x158/+0x160), runs conditional cleanup on sub-objects at +0xE0 and +0x118, chains to the base destructor, and frees itself when the delete flag is set.

classes.name: UIRenderDispatcher
classes.responsibility: Main text render dispatcher: resolves the stored text pointer (+0xB0) through the shared string table when the +0xE8 flag is set, derives the alignment mode (1 left / 2 center / 3 right) from the alignment string (+0xB8), measures the text in the render box (+0x4..+0x10), fits or truncates against the width limit (+0xE4), re-centers on overflow, and dispatches the draw by alignment mode.

state_machines.name: TextAlignmentMode
transitions: The first character of the alignment string at this+0xB8 selects the mode: 'L' -> Left, 'C' -> Center, 'R' -> Right; the resulting mode is stored at +0xE0 and the draw is dispatched by it. Transition triggers beyond the stored flag are not evidenced in the packet.

state_machines.name: NetworkGameSearchState
transitions: While the session manager query (VehicleStateQueryAtLargeOffset on dword_7CD25C) reports searching, the browser shows the Searching status item; otherwise it shows the No-games-available status item. A non-zero game count with an idle manager populates the session rows. The search-to-idle completion transition is not evidenced in the packet.

interfaces.name: IUIListAccessor
interfaces.purpose: Indexed access into a UI string list plus name search and selection, used to fetch display strings, locate existing rows, and restore a search selection.

interfaces.name: IUIMenuItemFactory
interfaces.purpose: Creates a menu row from a name string and sets row name/outline color, used for session rows, standings rows, stat rows, status items, and file-browser rows.

interfaces.name: IUITextRender
interfaces.purpose: Measures text against a target width and draws text/bitmaps by alignment mode.

interfaces.name: IUIStringFormat
interfaces.purpose: Buffer-safe string formatting with overflow checking and string-length recompute, used to assemble menu row strings and edit-buffer text.

interfaces.name: IUIStateCleanup
interfaces.purpose: Notifies the owning UI state machine that a list is being refreshed before repopulation.

interfaces.name: IUIStringTable
interfaces.purpose: Looks a token string up in the shared string table (byte_5EC4C0) into the shared result buffer (byte_5EC4CC), backing translated and status messages.

interfaces.name: IUITextField
interfaces.purpose: Accesses UI text fields: reads the current screen text and updates the UI edit buffer with a formatted string.

compatibility_contracts.name: UIElementTextUpdateContract
compatibility_contracts.description: When the bound mode/config value differs from the cached value, the element formats a representation (list string or raw integer via '%d') into a fixed stack buffer using overflow-checked formatting and pushes it into the UI edit buffer; the update method returns 0.

compatibility_contracts.name: MenuPageRebuildContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Before repopulating, free the entry-list node chain at +0x44 (nodes with payload at node+0, next pointer at node+4, flag byte at node+8) and clear +0x44..+0x50, then notify state cleanup, insert new entries, and create menu items only for names not already present.

compatibility_contracts.name: NetworkBrowserSessionRowContract
compatibility_contracts.description: One menu row per session built as description + translated session name + '%d/%d' player count + '%d' session id; row outline color is grey when the locked/joined flag is set, red when the player-count bit flag holds, otherwise black. When no rows exist, show the Searching status item while the manager is searching and the No-games-available item otherwise.

compatibility_contracts.name: TextFitTruncationContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Menu-item text is measured character-by-character with the text renderer against the available width and truncated at the character index where the width is exceeded (with a midpoint correction); the render dispatcher truncates to the +0xE4 width limit, and when the limit is disabled re-centers the text in the box on overflow.

compatibility_contracts.name: OptionsCategoryEntryContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The option-category argument stored at +0xF4 selects the label set inserted into the options list: Allowed/Disallowed for categories 484-494, On/Off for 498, Normal plus X2..X7 speed multipliers for 499-500, and Normal/Time Scaled/Selected Season for 501.

compatibility_contracts.name: StringTableResolutionContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Text flagged by the +0xE8 string-table flag is resolved through the shared string table (BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, text, byte_5EC4CC)) before display; the shared buffer byte_5EC4CC is also used as the carrier for search-status text.

compatibility_contracts.name: VcrFileBrowserContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The browser scans the replay directory with the aVcr_0 pattern, strips file extensions, creates one menu item per file, and re-selects the saved file name; the selection flag at +0x131 is cleared before the scan.

unresolved: The concrete class names behind the UIElementBase constructor template are not identified by the packet; the instances are distinguished only by installed vtable and the preset at +0x334.
Field +0x31C is dual-use: constructors store a pointer to a bound global there, while UIFrontendCounterDisplayUpdate caches an integer. Common ownership of the two uses is not proven by the packet.
UICameraConstructor2 follows the same template as UIElementBase, but prior analysis labels its owner UICamera; no packet evidence proves whether the camera shares the element base class.

The three menu rebuilders (UIMenuPagePopulator, TeamStatsMenuBuilder, GameOptionsUIConstructor) share the entry-list layout at +0x44..+0x50 but use different base initialization (StateCleanupNotification vs ConstructorInitVTable) and different subtype fields (+0xA0/+0xA8, +0xF4, +0x174); whether they are one class is unproven.
Field +0xE0 is interpreted as a text-buffer pointer in MenuItemRenderHelper and as an alignment-mode int in UILargeRenderDispatcher; the packet does not prove these are the same object type.
Semantics of the preset values at +0x334 (271, 381-387, 398) and the meaning of the flag fields at +0x324..+0x330 are unknown.

The linked-list node layout used at +0x44 (payload at +0, next at +4, flag byte at +8) appears in three functions, but the node type and the meaning of the -1 insertion key in LinkedListInsertWithNodeAllocation are unidentified.
The network-session info query is invoked indirectly (loc_462010) and is not present in the packet callee table; the session-id ceiling 9999 and the v25 semantics are inferred from usage only.
The sub-objects cleaned by ConditionalDualCleanup at +0xE0 and +0x118 in UIListObjectDestructor, and the purpose of the three freed buffers (+0x150/+0x158/+0x160), are not evidenced.
The base-destructor chain target sub_485EB0 and the base-init sub_48C070 are not characterized by this packet.
The callers of the VCR browser and the menu page populator are not evidenced in the packet (caller refs for the page populator are listed unresolved).
The format-string associations (aS_4 '%s' at 0x005C2C18, aD_1 '%d' at 0x005C3280, aSSS_0 at 0x005C6784) are DERIVED from IDA naming conventions rather than pinned by the raw source.
